allocation_objective: Maximize eligible development-family coverage within the exact global class/joint quotas.
Minimize repeated family-lakara assignments; only Lun may repeat.
Minimize sum of squared family loads.
tie_breaking: Seeded sorted input edges; no task outcomes read for membership.
PN_assignment: Exact global PN margins via integral flow, restricting each exact family/cell/PN tuple to one occurrence. Prefer unique PN per family; if that matching is infeasible, allow repeated PN across distinct cells only, preserving tuple novelty.
novelty: Exclude every normalized matching grammar tuple in both campaign ledgers. The development families are all previously exposed in broader campaigns; report current-recipe exposure separately.
reason: Larger fresh-tuple Opus confirmation of the same45%-Lun/10%-passive/three-recipe/class mixture with maximum family coverage and larger family loads, before committing scarce OpenAI funding. This improves development calibration and Opus dependence evidence; it is not an independent-family validation or a substitute for unseen test evaluation.
analysis: Use canonical completed predicate. Report all-request, usable, missing-response bounds, iid and family sandwich SE, whole-family bootstrap sensitivity, recipe/tense/voice/class strata, family loads, and prior same-recipe exposure groups. No reweighting, trimming or new membership based on individual errors.
fixed_decision_rule: Analyze advancement only after all2400 primary requests settle. Advance this unchanged mixture toward separately approved final evaluation only if audited all-request and usable Opus point estimates and worst/best missing-response bounds are all within79–81%, with retained-scope validity resolved. Otherwise preserve this failed screen and do not claim target attainment. This is development confirmation, not a final qualification or independent-family replication. No interim score-based stopping, provider replay or answer-based replacement.

transport.order: Each joint recipe×lakara×voice cell is divided equally by seeded input order, then each chunk is independently shuffled. All2400 membership and both chunks are fixed before any provider answers.
transport.second_batch_condition: Submit second1200 only after first1200 settles and the coordinator financial gate allows it; do not stop based on first-batch scores.
transport.budget_failure: If fixed2400 cannot be completed within unchanged cumulative caps, report an incomplete confirmation and no qualification. Budget subdivisions are not inferential stages.

evaluation_authorization: No provider submission or paid authorization created. Parent alone counts tokens, checks shared caps/reserves, submits and settles both chunks.
precision_limit: Larger N lowers iid variance, but repeated families and multiple aorists can keep family SE above1pp. Opus covariance does not identify Astra repeated-aorist covariance.
